title: 陳怡君請上車
subject: Number 17 of forty-three women all named 陳怡君 on their namesake club's coach trip, where roll call is one name answered forty-three times; when a rest-area loudspeaker pages the late one, three strangers with that name come running too.
caption: Mandarin square-dance folk-disco, Chinese minzu-style dance-floor groove. Dizi bamboo flute playing a staccato pentatonic hook, erhu doubling the chorus melody with slides, octave-bouncing synth bass, four-on-the-floor kick with off-beat open hi-hat and handclaps, bright synth-brass stabs. Bright polished dance mix with big handclaps. Female lead, bright chest-voice belt in a mid-high register with folk-style turns, women's unison group answering the name in the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 130 BPM, A minor. Boisterous, proud coach-party comic mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - dizi hook, handclaps, synth bass]

[Verse 1]
遊覽車上四十三個人
全部都叫陳怡君
導遊拿著名單點名
點一個 全車都答應

[Chorus]
陳怡君 請上車
陳怡君 在這裡
陳怡君 請上車
四十三個 一起答到

[Verse 2]
休息站的大喇叭響
陳怡君小姐 請回車上
我們四十三個全回頭
遲到的那位 還在廁所

[Pre-Chorus]
這時三個陌生人
拎著包包跑過來
她們也叫陳怡君
導遊的頭都大了

[Chorus]
陳怡君 請上車
陳怡君 在這裡
陳怡君 請上車
路人怡君 也擠上來

[Chorus]
陳怡君 請上車
陳怡君 在這裡
陳怡君 請上車
全都到齊 一起出發

[Outro - dizi, synth brass fade]
十七號怡君 坐好了
